    bool            boolean

        return "datetime"

        return "duration"
    elif isinstance(x, StringDtype):
        return "string"
    elif isinstance(x, ExtensionDtype):
        return "any"
    elif is_string_dtype(x):
        return "string"
    else:
        return "any"
